activity.notes: Carl Gustaf Emil Mannerheim was elected President of Finland on 4 August 1944 and resigned on 4 March 1946. ATLAS records this constitutional presidency as his representative political Activity. His earlier service as Commander-in-Chief and wartime Marshal is historically central but is not added as a parallel Activity in this registration in order to preserve one primary person–polity representation.

sources.title: Former Presidents of the Republic of Finland
sources.citation_text: The official Presidency of Finland lists Carl Gustaf Emil Mannerheim as President of the Republic from 1944 to 1946.

sources.title: Gustaf Mannerheim – Chronology
sources.citation_text: The Mannerheim Museum chronology records his election as President on 4 August 1944 and his resignation on 4 March 1946.

sources.title: President Paasikivi's speech on Mannerheim's resignation
sources.citation_text: The Paasikivi archive reproduces material associated with Mannerheim's resignation from the presidency in March 1946.
